title: Travis Taylor zapped at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: Taylor was mouthing off and they give him this little zap, you know, with the the radioactivities.

plain: A man named Travis Taylor, investigating at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, is said to have been "mouthing off" and then given a "little zap" of something like radioactivity, sometime in the 2020s. The researcher Grant Cameron tells this on Michels' show, passing it along without naming his source. Told this way, it suggests whatever is at the ranch reacts to the people there.
